source: 2012/TSB Vol 12 No 10 (supercedes TSB Vol 12 No 9) Important Optimizer  Update.pdf
title: Optimizer Service Procedure Update
lead: This bulletin supersedes Vol. 12 No. 9: further in-house testing found that the catalytic converter stays within normal operating temperature during an Optimizer service at 2000 RPM, as originally instructed. Disregard Vol. 12 No. 9.
body: Perform all Optimizer services per the directions on the 16501 label, and do not exceed 2000 RPM.
The Optimizer "Do-It-Right" documents have been revised to match. MOC highly recommends giving them to every account that purchases Optimizer.
